housing.summary: Numbeo reported a CAD 1,480.50 average monthly rent for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment in June 2026; Saskatchewan limits a security deposit to one calendar month of rent. No uniquely designated main local rental portal was supported; the City lists several search options.

banking.summary: RBC says newcomers opening an account must be at least 18 and live in Canada, and it verifies identity from original government-issued documents.
required_docs: permanent resident card or work permit

schools.summary: Luther College High School in Regina offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in grades 11 and 12; Saskatchewan publishes an official list of independent schools that includes Luther College High School.

legal_admin.summary: For a newly landed permanent resident, provide a Canadian address to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada within 180 days of arrival so the first permanent resident card can be delivered.
legal_admin.registration_step: Provide a Canadian address to IRCC within 180 days of arriving to receive the first permanent resident card.

tax_finance.summary: Obtain a Social Insurance Number from Service Canada by applying online, by mail or in person with one status-proving primary identity document and one valid secondary identity document showing legal name and date of birth.

transport.summary: Regina Transit is the municipal network and its adult monthly pass is CAD 97. New Saskatchewan residents may drive on a valid out-of-province licence for 90 days; eligible licences from honoured jurisdictions may be exchanged, while non-recognized licences require examination. Newcomers register for public healthcare by applying for a Saskatchewan health card through Saskatchewan Account and providing proof of legal entitlement to Canada and Saskatchewan residence.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Exchange within 90 days of moving to Saskatchewan; licences from honoured jurisdictions may be exchanged subject to SGI requirements, while a licence from a non-recognized jurisdiction requires a driver examination.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for a Saskatchewan health card online through Saskatchewan Account (or by mail or in person) with proof of legal entitlement to be in Canada and proof of Saskatchewan residence.
